name: Jinbo Maria
source:
"The Protagonist's Homeroom Teacher"

The teacher in charge of the class the protagonist attends. She has the air of a mature woman.

She isn't overly strict, but she knows when to be firm. She appears to have a connection to Natsume.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/dmc/cha/cha06.html]official site[/url]]
